subject: Discovery follow-up: technical deep dive & demo scheduling — proposal for global demo windows
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@forgedata.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: technical deep dive & demo scheduling — proposal for global demo windows

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for carving out time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a clear ask for the next step so we can get the right folks scheduled.

Summary (short):
- Key priorities: reduce tail latency for multi-region customers, predictable per-token costs at scale, and VPC-ready private deployment for regulated datasets.
- Stakeholders you said would join the next call: Cloud infra lead (Rohit), Principal SW Engineer (Rohan), and Procurement.

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute technical deep dive + demo (runtime, routing, quantization options) with live Q&A. Because you have stakeholders in US/EU/APAC, I sketched a small "demo bridge" schedule to avoid repeated late-night meetings for any one region. The idea is to rotate an anchor time each week so the burden is shared across teams.

Proposal: three anchor windows (each repeats weekly, switch anchor each week):
- Anchor A — Americas-friendly: Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (works for early EU as evening)
- Anchor B — Europe-friendly: Wed 14:00 CEST / 08:00 ET (good overlap for EU & US mornings)
- Anchor C — APAC-friendly: Thu 09:00 SGT / Wed 20:00 PT (friendly for APAC mornings)

Please pick two preferred anchors (rank 1/2) or propose alternatives. Once you confirm, Marissa will send a rotating calendar series (ICS) we can accept — attendees can pick which occurrences they can join; recordings remain available.

Attachments: requirements_matrix.xlsx (your notes + our ask list), demo_bridge_calendar.ics (template proposal).

Short asks:
1) Confirm who from your team needs to be on the deep dive (Rohit, Rohan, security/SSO contact).
2) Pick two preferred anchor windows (A/B/C) or drop your preferred times.
3) Any specific infra constraints (VPC peering, allowed egress IPs) we should prep for ahead of the call?

I can be flexible on the agenda, but plan to allocate 25–30 minutes for architecture and 25–40 for live demo & Q&A depending on the depth you want.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

Best,
Priyom
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai

--

Priyom —

Thanks for the clear recap. The demo bridge idea is smart and should help our team avoid shipping the burden on ops to late nights. Our initial preferences:

1) Anchor B (Europe-friendly) — best for our EU engineers and gives our US folks a morning option if it's scheduled earlier in ET.
2) Anchor C (APAC-friendly) as the second choice — Rohit is in Singapore and prefers mornings.

Attendees I'll confirm after checking calendars: Rohan (SW), Rohit (Cloud), and I’ll loop in our security lead (Maya) if it looks like we need to talk SSO/SCIM. Procurement is on copy; they may want a separate short pre-proc call once we get a demo date.

Please go ahead and propose the rotating series; I prefer a recurring invite that rotates anchor each week. 1 hour is fine to start.

Thanks,
Alex Nguyen
Director of Platform Engineering — ForgeData
alex.nguyen@forgedata.com
